subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should shipped plugins that set `requireApproval.timeoutBehavior: "allow"` retain that behavior during a named deprecation release, or should this PR intentionally enforce an immediate fail-closed cutover?
rationale: The exact head still publishes and accepts the plugin field while ignoring it at runtime; selecting compatibility versus immediate fail-closed policy requires maintainer intent rather than a mechanical review judgment.

options.title: Preserve during deprecation
options.body: Honor timeout-allow for one named release window while warning, documenting removal, and testing both upgrade and fresh-install behavior.

options.title: Approve immediate fail-closed
options.body: Intentionally break timeout-allow now, with explicit upgrade communication and evidence showing affected plugins fail safely.

recommendation.title: Preserve during deprecation
recommendation.body: Honor timeout-allow for one named release window while warning, documenting removal, and testing both upgrade and fresh-install behavior.
